text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Russian foreign minister and Iraq's foreign under-secretary discuss in Moscow enhancing bilateral ties.
- A British non-governmental organisation calls for lifting Iraq sanctions.
- Arab League chief calls for establishing an Arab common market.
(The above stories were also carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Jordanian dignitaries call for end to sanctions on Iraq.
